answer: Every identity joins a harbor pool of 20 agents posting $100 cover each, and the epoch's first proven fraud burns $100 from it. Five rotating auditors check one signed log per identity at the wharf each epoch, and a failed check publishes its fable to the harbor log. Fable number n burns $100 times n, so fraud ten costs $1,000 and fraud one hundred $10,000. Forging 100 clones burns $505,000; 100 honest agents lose $0 and reclaim cover. A drained pool freezes its 20 members for 10 epochs. Fraud spreads like a harbor fire, first spark a bucket, hundredth the whole dock.
